final: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) as ratio_avg, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) as overall_avg FROM media_type_stats), kept_groups AS (SELECT mts.ratio_avg, mts.track_count, mts.ratio_avg - oa.overall_avg as difference FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa WHERE mts.ratio_avg > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) as avg_ratio, AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM kept_groups
